BACKSEAT local system sound perception

YAMNet v1: Google / TensorFlow Models
https://github.com/tensorflow/models/tree/master/research/audioset/yamnet

ONNX conversion: Audio Magic (audiomagic/yamnet-onnx)
Pinned revision: f25b741c2f0bdc6d7e6db24b5fddda23347dbafd
https://huggingface.co/audiomagic/yamnet-onnx
The converter reports a TensorFlow-to-ONNX format conversion with unchanged weights.
This is a third-party conversion, not an official Google ONNX release.
The converter's README.md and Apache-2.0 LICENSE accompany the model.

AudioSet class labels: Google AudioSet
https://research.google.com/audioset/
CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
yamnet_class_map.csv is copied unchanged from the pinned conversion repository.
BACKSEAT separately displays Korean translations for selected labels in its UI.

BACKSEAT changes: local Windows output capture, bounded decoding, sound scores,
separate game-dialogue transcription, and contextual spectator prompts.
No model weights have been fine-tuned by BACKSEAT.
